findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product transfers to the client immediately upon creation rather than upon full payment, leaving you unprotected if the client withholds payment.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Services, the Provider hereby assigns to the Client all right, title, and interest in the deliverables created specifically for the Client under this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a small adjustment before signing: - In the relevant clause, ownership of the work product transfers immediately upon creation rather than upon full payment; I suggest updating this so that the assignment of rights takes effect upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services. Thank you, and I look forward to moving ahead.
